name: open-admin-panel
description: Open the debug console (if closed), type the 'admin' command, press Enter, and verify the ADMIN PANEL overlay launches

steps._comment: DBG toggle - admins only (App.jsx:613 gates on isAdmin)
Open console only if not already open
DebugConsole input is controlled React state (HUD.jsx:953)

steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); if (!el) return 'ERR: no debug input'; if (el.value !== 'admin') { const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(el, 'admin'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.focus(); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13, bubbles: true })); return 'submitted value=' + JSON.stringify(el.value); })()
steps.name: press Enter on 'admin'
steps._comment: handleKey fires onCommand(input) on Enter; native setter keeps React state in sync if type() bypassed it
AdminOverlay header (AdminOverlay.jsx:841) - no testid, match by text
